把笔记／会议记录整理成文

zh: （对呆账的）拨回；拨回资产的账面值
en: a situation where an asset gets a value which it was thought to have lost; an amount of money entered in the financial records because of this

zh: （资产等账面价值的）减记，划减
en: a reduction in the value of assets, etc.
ex: a £100 000 write-down in the value of the property
价值10万英镑的资产减记

en: a vote for somebody who is not an official candidate in an election, in which you write their name on your ballot paper

zh: a candidate in an election for public office whose name is not printed on the official list of candidates, usually because he or she has not been selected by a political party. People voting for such a candidate must therefore write his or her name on the voting paper. Some use this write-in vote, or write-in, as a form of protest by writing silly names on the voting paper.
en: a candidate in an election for public office whose name is not printed on the official list of candidates, usually because he or she has not been selected by a political party. People voting for such a candidate must therefore write his or her name on the voting paper. Some use this write-in vote, or write-in, as a form of protest by writing silly names on the voting paper.
a vehicle that has been so badly damaged in an accident that cannot be repaired or would cost more to repair than to replace
ex: She survived the crash with minor injuries, but the car was a write-off.
她在碰撞中幸存，受了点儿轻伤，但汽车报废了。

en: to protect the information on a computer disk from being changed or deleted (= destroyed)
an article in a newspaper or magazine in which somebody writes what they think about a new book, play, product, etc.
ex: The performance got a good write-up in the local press.
当地报纸刊登了赞扬这次演出的评论文章。

en: a person whose job is writing books, stories, articles, etc.
ex: Who's your favourite writer?
你最喜欢的作家是谁？

zh: （写作人的）灵感障碍，神思枯竭，写作笔障
en: a problem that writers sometimes have when they cannot think of what to write and have no new ideas
ex: He's just published a new novel after two years of writer's block.
经过两年的作家阻挠，他才出版了一部新小说。

zh: 书写痉挛（长时间写字造成的手部疼痛或僵硬感）
en: a pain or stiff feeling in the hand caused by writing for a long time

zh: （常指因剧痛不停地）扭动，翻滚
en: to twist or move your body without stopping, often because you are in great pain
ex: She was writhing around on the floor in agony.
她痛得在地板上直打滚。

en: the activity of writing, in contrast to reading, speaking, etc.
ex: Our son’s having problems with his reading and writing (= at school)
我们儿子在读写方面有困难。

zh: a piece of furniture with a surface for writing on and often separate sections for pens and paper
en: a piece of furniture with a surface for writing on and often separate sections for pens and paper
paper for writing letters on

zh: 以书信（或文件等）形式的；书面的；成文的；正式的
en: expressed in writing rather than in speech
ex: Having a written record of what I've done is very valuable.
写下我所做的事情非常有价值。

zh: 错误的；不对的；不正确的
引起问题（或麻烦）；有毛病；不正常
不合适的；不适当的；不合意的
en: not right or correct
ex: I got all the answers wrong.
我的答案全都错了。

zh: 使措手不及；使窘态毕露
en: to put somebody in a difficult or embarrassing situation by doing something that they do not expect
ex: It was an attempt to wrong-foot the opposition.
这一举动为的是让对手措手不及。

zh: 判断错误的；执迷不悟的
en: having or showing bad judgement and refusing to change your opinion or ideas
ex: wrong-headed beliefs
错误的信念
